entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling about an order I received a little while ago. I'd like to return a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Carbon Cycling Shoes, delivered on October 23rd. That was 42 days ago. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a fit issue. I've tried them on several rides, but they're giving me terrible blisters on my heels. I've also had a lot of trouble getting the cleats positioned correctly, which I've never had with other shoes.
I'm sorry to hear they're causing blisters and not working out for you. Let me just double-check our return policy for you... one moment.

Okay, thanks for waiting. I've confirmed that standard items like these shoes fall under our 90-day return window. Since you're at day 42, you are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you.

That's great news, I appreciate that. Now, since I had to go out and buy another pair of shoes in the meantime and went through some hassle with these, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future VeloFit purchase? For the inconvenience.

I understand your position, but our policy allows for the full refund on the item itself, which I've initiated. Unfortunately, I'm not authorized to provide additional discounts on top of the return. The good news is you'll receive a full refund for the cycling shoes as soon as we receive them back.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. A full refund is fair. What do I need to do to send them back?

Of course. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account. Just package the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Your refund will be processed once our warehouse confirms receipt. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
